title: MGR SYSTEMS ARCHITECT - INDIA
description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

**The Role**
------------

Team Management: Mgr. Systems Architects manage a team of 6 to 10 Sr. system architects, lead architects, and associate managers, assigning them to the right Agile Release Trains (ARTs).
  
Guidance and Mentorship: They guide and enable the team to deliver designs efficiently, mentor reportees, and ensure they contribute towards achieving business goals and managing technical debt.
  
Architectural Oversight: They oversee system design and roadmap, drive architectural initiatives, identify opportunities for optimization, and ensure designs adhere to Lumen Enterprise IT guidelines.
  
Coordination Across ARTs: Mgr. Systems Architects ensure technology alignments across ARTs, confirm capabilities meet Definition of Ready (DoR), and review estimates and critical features by working with other architects.
  
Production Performance and Stability: They maintain full awareness of application performance in production environments, participate in SWAT calls to address stability issues, and help document root causes.
  
Engagement and Collaboration: They engage with system architects, outside vendors, and various teams to review and ensure the success of designs, and participate in Continuous Exploration processes.

**The Main Responsibilities**
-----------------------------

* Manage a team of 6 to 10 Sr. system architects / lead architects / associate mgr system architects and assign to right ARTs.
* Guide and enable the team to deliver designs efficiently
* Enable system architects in the team to own and contribute towards achieving business goals and technical debt.
* Understand overall system design and roadmap
* Drive architectural initiatives and identify opportunities for optimization
* Oversee, mentor and guide reportees.
* Identify areas where POCs are required and assign to reportees as appropriate and track the same to completion.
* Mgr System Architects manage reportees working across ARTs.
* Ensure technology alignments across ARTs; align teams of multiple ARTs to a shared technical direction by working with respective ART System architects
* Confirm Capability meets Definition of Ready (DoR) before approving for multiple ARTs
* Attend and participate in Mass Markets Architecture Review Boards
* Review Capability estimates by working closely with other system architects across ARTs.
* Ensure ART system designs adhere to Lumen Enterprise IT roadmap, guidelines, principles
* Review critical enabler Features and NFRs created by ART architects
* Engage with other system architects and establish an integrated technical design
* Engage with outside vendors to ensure design success
* Engage system architects to review designs and ensure complete end to end success (ie. Omni channel, flow through, etc.)
* Actively participate in the Continuous Exploration (keeping up with the industry) process as part of the Continuous Delivery Pipeline, especially with Enabler Epics
* Collaborate with their application/service development team, Load and Performance team, chaos engineering team, SRE SPOC etc.
* Have full awareness of application/service performance in production environment, upstream / downstream applications, database performance characteristics etc.
* Participate in Proactive / Reactive SWAT calls to address production stability issues, help teams on identifying and documenting accurate root cause of issues.
* Review ART technical enabler Feature content
* Review ART environment performance, stability, and scalability targets
* Review critical nonfunctional requirements. Provide inputs based on production stability, performance issues, bottle necks, User experience issues, security etc.
* Review ART system designs focused on system components which align to the larger end state designs
* Review ART technical system design documents
* Review deisgn of subsystems and their interfaces; allocate responsibilities to subsystems; understand design deployment; communicate requirements for interactions within design context.
* Review ART data flow, sources, storage, format
* Review technical and architectural vision for the ARTs and provide inputs to system architects

**What We Look For in a Candidate**
-----------------------------------

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  

* Minimum 10 years of software development experience, with deep expertise in C#, .NET / .NET Core, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework / EF Core, and LINQ.
* At least 3 years in a solution/application architect role, an engineering manager role, or both.
* Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise applications on Microsoft Azure.
* Strong expertise in microservices, API design, distributed systems, and design patterns (including SOLID, domain-driven design, CQRS, and event-driven architecture).
* Deep experience with Microsoft SQL Server: data modeling, complex T-SQL, stored procedures, indexing, query and performance tuning, execution plans, and transaction and locking behavior.
* Experience with GitHub, GitHub Actions, and modern CI/CD and DevOps practices.
* Strong knowledge of application security, including OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, Azure AD / Entra ID, secrets management, and secure handling of sensitive financial data.
* Experience with observability and production support tools such as Application Insights and Azure Monitor.
* Experience leading Agile/Scrum teams using Jira (Confluence is a plus).
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience working across time zones with US-based leadership and business teams.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills
  

* AI/ML: experience designing or delivering AI/ML or LLM-powered solutions (RAG, agents, Semantic Kernel, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning).
* Palantir: exposure to Palantir Foundry or AIP.
* Python: hands-on experience with Python for services, automation, or data work.
* Multi-cloud: experience architecting across AWS or Google Cloud in addition to Azure.
* Containers and orchestration with Docker and Kubernetes (AKS).
* Infrastructure as Code with Terraform or Bicep.
* Front-end architecture experience with Angular, React, or Blazor.
* Experience with messaging and streaming platforms (Azure Service Bus, Event Grid, Kafka).
* Domain knowledge in billing, payments, invoicing, collections, revenue management, or other financial systems, ideally in telecom or large enterprise.

  

What We're Looking For
  

* A leader who balances hands-on technical depth with strong people management.
* A strategic thinker who can set a clear technical direction and turn it into practical delivery plans.
* Someone who builds trust across teams and time zones through clear, proactive communication.
* A mentor who enjoys developing engineers and raising the bar for the whole team.
* Someone excited to help the team adopt cloud and AI in a responsible, business-focused way.

title: SQA Manager
description:
**Introduction**  

Welcome to Gallagher in India — where expertise, technology, and purpose come together. Since 2006, Gallagher in India has supported global teams by delivering quality, service, and speed through deep expertise, smart technology, and specialized knowledge services. More than just an operations center, it’s a place where careers grow through collaboration, continuous learning, and purposeful work. We drive efficiency, compliance, and innovation so our teams can focus on serving clients. If you enjoy solving problems and working with purpose, Gallagher is the place where you can grow and feel a sense of belonging.

  
**Overview**

Gallagher Center of Excellence is seeking a Senior QA Engineer with 10–15 years of relevant experience to lead quality engineering for Gallagher Drive analytics products. The role will define and govern the QA strategy across Power BI reports and dashboards, data and ETL pipelines, APIs, and supporting applications. The Senior QA Engineer will provide hands-on technical leadership, establish repeatable QA processes and controls, guide automation architecture using Python, PyTest, and Playwright, drive risk-based release readiness, mentor QA resources, and partner with business, product, development, data, and reporting leaders. This is a senior technical individual-contributor role; direct people-management responsibility should be confirmed separately by the hiring manager.

  
  
**How you'll make an impact**

**Responsibilities:**

* **QA Strategy and Governance:** Define the end-to-end quality strategy, operating model, risk-based test approach, entry and exit criteria, evidence standards, release gates, sign-off controls, SOPs, checklists, and regression governance across analytics products.
* **Test Leadership and Assurance:** Lead planning and assurance for functional, integration, system, regression, data, API, ETL, reporting, smoke, performance, security-related, and release validation; ensure appropriate coverage across critical business journeys.
* **Power BI Quality Engineering:** Establish testing standards for data accuracy, DAX calculations, semantic models, filters, slicers, interactions, drill-through, navigation, refresh behavior, role-based access, visual standards, accessibility, and performance.
* **Data and ETL Quality Leadership:** Define source-to-target reconciliation controls and data-quality rules across source systems, ETL pipelines, Snowflake or equivalent warehouse layers, semantic models, and reporting outputs.
* **Automation Strategy and Architecture:** Define scalable automation architecture using Python, PyTest, Playwright, API frameworks, reusable libraries, test-data utilities, reporting, and CI/CD integration. Prioritize automation based on risk, business value, repeatability, effort, and maintainability.
* **Visual Regression and Baseline Governance:** Establish Playwright or comparable browser automation for Power BI navigation, screenshot capture, visual comparison, threshold management, approved baseline updates, and defect triage for unexpected changes.
* **Azure DevOps Traceability and Controls:** Establish requirements-to-test-to-defect traceability, evidence standards, dashboards, workflow controls, defect templates, and execution reporting in Azure DevOps or an approved comparable tool.
* **Defect Governance and Root Cause Analysis:** Lead defect triage, severity and priority alignment, defect-ageing reviews, root-cause analysis, corrective-action tracking, fix verification, and learning from escaped defects.
* **Release Readiness and Executive Reporting:** Provide concise decision-oriented reporting on requirements and test coverage, execution progress, defect trends, open high-severity risks, automation coverage, dependencies, residual exposure, and release recommendations.
* **Cross-Functional Quality Leadership:** Partner with product owners, business analysts, engineering leaders, data engineers, Power BI developers, architects, scrum masters, security teams, and business stakeholders to make requirements testable and address quality risks early.
* **Capability Building and Knowledge Sustainability:** Mentor QA engineers, conduct reviews, define reusable templates and assets, maintain current operating procedures, facilitate knowledge transfer, improve backup readiness, and reduce dependency on individual subject-matter experts.
* **Continuous Improvement and Innovation:** Use quality metrics, defect patterns, delivery retrospectives, and value-stream analysis to identify process improvements. Evaluate AI-assisted testing, specification-driven approaches, and new tooling through governed proofs of concept.
* **Compliance, Security and Test Data:** Ensure QA practices follow approved privacy, masking, access-control, environment, open-source package, and secure test-data requirements.
* **Stakeholder and Delivery Management:** Manage competing QA priorities across products, communicate trade-offs and resource constraints, escalate blockers early, and align testing investment with customer and business outcomes.

  
  
**About you**

**Qualifications:**

* 10–15 years of software quality assurance experience, including technical leadership for complex data, analytics, reporting, API, and application testing.
* Demonstrated experience defining QA strategy, governance, standards, entry and exit criteria, evidence expectations, release gates, and sign-off recommendations.
* Advanced SQL and data-validation capability covering reconciliation, profiling, joins, aggregations, transformation-rule validation, and investigation of data discrepancies.
* Strong Power BI quality-assurance experience covering DAX, semantic models, data, interactions, role-based access, refresh, performance, visual standards, and regression governance.
* Strong data and ETL testing experience with Snowflake, Azure Synapse, SQL Server, SSMS, ADF, or comparable cloud data platforms and pipeline technologies.
* Hands-on Python and PyTest experience, including reusable framework design, fixtures, utilities, assertions, reporting, and automation maintainability.
* Experience with Playwright or a comparable browser automation framework for UI and visual regression testing and baseline governance.
* Experience with API testing, CI/CD integration, source control, automated execution reporting, and controlled adoption of open-source packages.
* Advanced Azure DevOps experience for test management, requirements traceability, defect governance, dashboards, sprint visibility, and quality reporting.
* Experience leading defect triage, root-cause analysis, risk assessment, release-readiness reviews, and executive or leadership-level quality reporting.
* Ability to mentor QA engineers, influence without formal authority, lead cross-functional quality discussions, and create sustainable knowledge-transfer practices.
* Strong business acumen, strategic communication, stakeholder management, prioritization, analytical thinking, and evidence-based decision-making.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience establishing or scaling a QA Center of Excellence or shared quality-engineering capability.
* Experience with AI-assisted testing, specification-driven test generation, automated defect creation, or governed use of enterprise AI platforms.
* Performance testing experience using JMeter, k6, or comparable tools; accessibility testing knowledge is an advantage.
* Knowledge of data lineage, metadata, observability, data contracts, masking, access controls, and secure non-production environments.
* Experience measuring automation return, manual-effort reduction, defect leakage, coverage, cycle time, and release confidence.
* ISTQB Advanced/Test Manager, CSQE, Microsoft Power BI, Snowflake, Azure, Python, Agile/Scrum, Lean Six Sigma, or related certification or training.

**Education And Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree required; a degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, data, or a related technical discipline is preferred.
* 10–15 years of relevant QA experience. Talent Acquisition and Compensation should confirm the final career level, career band, and education wording before publication.

* Competitive compensation

* Career development opportunities and ongoing learning
* A collaborative, people-first culture with accessible leadership
* The opportunity to do meaningful work with global reach and local impact

At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles.

*Gallagher is an affirmative action/equal opportunity employer (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)*

The **Senior AI Evals Test Engineer** is a hands-on technical role responsible for defining, developing, and executing robust evaluation frameworks and test strategies for AI agents built using the **Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) or similar sort of agentic frameworks**. **Opportunity Overview:**  
  
As a Principal Consultant (Delivery Enterprise Architect) within the Dell organization, aligned to Consulting Service Delivery, you will provide consultative business and technical delivery services for a range of complex customer-facing consulting engagements, in partnership with Global Pre-Sales, Account Management and Solutioning Teams. Specifically, you will be part of projects deploying, administering and configurating Large Language Model and Generative AI software stacks. These projects will focus on allowing Dell customers to deploy and fine-tune GenAI models.  
  
Also, as the senior-most technical member of the Services Delivery team, for the GenAI/Data Science Practice, you will work alongside other Dell badged Consultants, to earn the customers trust through competence, technical acumen, consulting expertise, and partnership. You would also be responsible for providing guidance/oversight to these individuals and technical grooming activities for their skill upgrading. This position requires a dynamic individual with expert customer-facing skills, leadership qualities and forecasting abilities for a particular technology and its lifecycle. The ability to guide customers and communicate technical processes and ideas is essential. These engagements often ensure that the customer is also enabled in the technologies being delivered.  
  
The person should have the common traits and capabilities that are listed in Section 2 (Essential Requirements) and meet many of the capabilities listed in Section 3 (Desirable Requirements).  
  
**Key Requirements:**  
  
**Experience and qualifications:**  
  

* 18+ years in the IT industry, preferably with a masters degree in Data Science, Machine Learning, or a related field.
* 8+ years in Artificial Intelligence and Big Data within a customer-facing services delivery role, including the ability to engage Data Scientists and assess their current and future ecosystems.
* 5+ years implementing and supporting infrastructure deployment, setup, and configuration through automation (agentic automation a strong plus).

  
**Generative & Agentic AI:**  
  

* Deep, hands-on knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs) and the broader Generative AI tooling ecosystem.
* Proven experience designing agentic AI solutions and agentic workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, CrewAI, Langfuse, and LangSmith.
* Familiarity with the NVIDIA AI software suite, including NVIDIA Base Command Manager (formerly Bright Cluster Manager), the NeMo framework, and Triton Inference Server.

  
**MLOps & AIOps Platforms:**  
  

* Deep understanding of the MLOps and AIOps ecosystem, with hands-on experience across platforms such as Kubeflow, MLflow, Run:ai, ClearML, Ray, H2O, and Cohere.

  
**Data Engineering & Distributed Systems:**  
  

* Extensive production experience with distributed query and processing engines Kafka, Trino (Starburst) and Apache Spark.
* Hands-on experience with modern table formats (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Hudi) for managing large-scale datasets.

* Deep understanding of columnar storage formats (Parquet, Avro) and how to optimize them for different query patterns.

  
**DevOps, IaC & CI/CD:**  
  

* Proven application of DevOps and Infrastructure-as-Code practices across both application development and infrastructure automation including desired-state configuration, GitOps, and CI/CD pipeline design.
* Extensive experience with CI/CD tooling such as GitLab, Argo CD, and Tekton.

  
**Kubernetes & Containers:**  
  

* Proven experience deploying and configuring Kubernetes (e.g., OpenShift), with deep knowledge of application deployments, Helm charts, and Kubernetes operators.
* Extensive experience building containerized applications, including container image signing.
* Knowledge of AI-related Kubernetes operators, such as the NVIDIA GPU, Network, and Storage operators.

* Ability to earn customer trust and to plan, organize, and lead customer workshops; excellent written and spoken English is essential.
* Comfortable working in efficient Agile teams (Scrum or Kanban), including extended pairing and enablement sessions that drive knowledge transfer in complex domains.

* Willingness and ability to be onsite for customer workshops and enablement sessions.
